 BOZEMAN, Mont. — Montana State will travel to Greeley for the second time in as many years to take on a Northern Colorado program they've dominated since 2007.
 The Bobcats have won 13 straight over the Bears since their last loss in 2007.
 This is the final road game of the season for Montana State who play rival Montana next week, but head coach Brent Vigen and his team have their focus on Northern Colorado in what is a potential trap game.
 "This team, the 2026 team, has to find a way to keep on improving through November so then we set ourselves up beyond that; but again there's no guarantees," said Vigen. "There's no looking beyond this week that needs to be done. It needs to be about how can we improve this week to take that step against a program that in my mind continues to improve."
 "Those guys got to focus on their game this week because they go play a team that we just played, and they're not thinking about us for sure," said wide receiver Dane Steel. "Next week means nothing if we don't take care of business this week."
 The Bears only have three wins this season, but their defense isn't to blame as they have the third best scoring defense in the Big Sky.
 "I think we got tested last week and our coaches had a good plan for us. I think at the end of the day, we got to find a way to just keep making plays," quarterback Justin Lamson said. "I have a lot of respect for Idaho State's defense then and same in Northern Colorado. You see their front, they get after people. Their defensive backs are really talented too so I'm just looking forward to another challenge."
 Coach Vigen noted how the interior can post a problem to establishing a ground attack.
 "There's an aggressive nature to how they play. There are some, I suppose, similarities in their ability to want to move and twist up front that has to be well thought out, well coordinated, and it certainly is. It makes it hard on a run game," Vigen said."
 Brayten Silbor is expected to start at quarterback for a Bear offense that ranks 11th in the Big Sky in scoring. 
 Kickoff against Northern Colorado is scheduled for noon on Saturday November 14.
